# Third-party test data

`jsrepository-excerpt.json` is an unmodified excerpt (14 of 76 libraries, detection and vulnerability fields only) of the retire.js repository,
https://github.com/RetireJS/retire.js, licensed under the Apache License 2.0.

`jquery-1.12.4.min.js` (jQuery, MIT) and `lodash-4.17.4.min.js` (Lodash, MIT) are the unmodified files published in the corresponding npm packages.
They are used only as test inputs and are not part of the shipped app.
